proposed_steps_not_executed.title: Cold baseline before any Steam/game launch
proposed_steps_not_executed.conditional_source: If the standard local save directory appears before execution, stop and include it after reviewing the changed scope; current absence is recorded, not created.
proposed_steps_not_executed.approval: Read complete save payloads for SHA256 and copy the listed app-specific tree/settings into a new nonsync destination. This is not approved yet; destination and permissions must be checked before creation.
proposed_steps_not_executed.method: Reconfirm no game/Steam writes and no other-device play. Reject links/path escapes and existing destination. Record relative path set, length, UTC time, attributes and SHA256. Copy without moving/deleting sources; compare all destination hashes, then source hashes/path set again. Any change/error makes the snapshot incomplete and stops launch. Keep A immutable; do not use mirror/purge modes.
proposed_steps_not_executed.verify: Verify a restore into a separate empty verification directory, never into originals. Preserve cache metadata as evidence; do not regard it as a Cloud restore mechanism. Keep backup outside Steam/cloud sync roots and git, and retain the successful manifest. No backup implementation or copy ran in this task.

proposed_steps_not_executed.title: Resolve Cloud boundary before experiment
proposed_steps_not_executed.approval: Separately authorize exact Steam startup, permitted UI inspection and per-game sync changes; any network blocking/offline transition needs its own explicit reviewed scope. The game-internal cloudSaving flag must not be silently changed.
proposed_steps_not_executed.method: Preserve A before reopening Steam, because startup may process synchronization. Inspect actual app Cloud status/settings and any conflict before game launch; do not force sync to make the display look clean. If remote inventory differs, preserve both versions separately and ask which baseline is authoritative. A remote backup, if desired, requires separately approved official authenticated read/download; no login or remote download occurred here.
proposed_steps_not_executed.stop: If the requirement is that the remote Cloud must not change at all, first approve and validate a concrete prevention mechanism before Steam startup. A local copy, temporary offline state, old success log or cache syncstate alone does not prove that condition. Do not alter firewall/global network settings automatically.
proposed_steps_not_executed.restore_rule: After a verified stable baseline/settings state, create separate baseline-B if needed; never replace A. Other devices must not play/sync during the experiment.

proposed_steps_not_executed.title: One bounded observed run
proposed_steps_not_executed.approval: Specific same-user debugger installation/run if needed, exact original/copy startup target and one bounded mouse/UI trace. A backup approval alone does not authorize these operations or save writes.
proposed_steps_not_executed.method: Use confirmed module paths/hashes and existing SetUI/LoadTableFile observation targets; new test character if approved. Even a new character may change shared stash/settings/global progress, so preserve the complete approved save tree. Stop for unexpected target, conflict, sync, resource or ownership failure. No real-character progression or broad account observation by default.
proposed_steps_not_executed.limits: Backup protects captured file bytes only. It cannot automatically roll back achievements, Cloud history, account/server-side effects, uncaptured data or debugger timing effects. Current Rea memory budget is not a measured original-game budget.

proposed_steps_not_executed.title: Review local recovery before reconnecting sync
proposed_steps_not_executed.approval: Any overwrite/rename of original saves, removal of test-only state and re-enabling Cloud require explicit exact recovery scope. No automatic newest-wins decision or cloud deletion.
proposed_steps_not_executed.method: After stopping only owned test processes and confirming writer quiescence, create a separate experiment-after snapshot. Compare A/B/after manifests. Restore the user-selected save/settings version only when approved and rehash it. Cache backup remains evidence; do not blindly replace/delete/remake remotecache.vdf to force sync. Preserve all generations until the user checks the result.
proposed_steps_not_executed.sync: Reopen/re-enable networking or Cloud only after local recovery review. If conflict is offered, stop for user choice of upload/download; do not infer from timestamps. Verify resulting sync and user-visible save state afterward under separate run approval.
